part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `StringValueFacetCounts` constructor (lucene/facet/src/java/org/apache/lucene/facet/StringValueFacetCounts.java:101): for low-cardinality fields with a `FacetsCollector`, `denseCounts` was left `null` with lazy initialization deferred to `countOneSegment`. When the query matched no documents, `count()` returned early before any segment counting, so `denseCounts` stayed `null` and `getTopChildren`/`getAllChildren` threw an NPE.

The fix eagerly allocates `denseCounts = new int[cardinality]` (and sets `initialized = true`) in that branch, matching the behavior of the count-all path. Verified: `TestStringValueFacetCounts` passes (9/9), and the full `:lucene:facet` test suite passes (286 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed).
